methods.header:
method MergeSorted(a: seq<int>, b: seq<int>) returns (r: seq<int>)
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |a| ==> a[i] <= a[j]
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |b| ==> b[i] <= b[j]
  ensures |r| == |a| + |b|
  ensures multiset(r) == multiset(a) + multiset(b)
  ensures forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |r| ==> r[i] <= r[j]

mutants.violation: Two distinct semantic defects: reversed head comparator selects the larger head first; off-by-one loop guard omits the final unconsumed input element

defects.description: reversed head comparator selects the larger head first
defects.independent_repair_note: Even when the last-element omission is repaired, the reversed comparator gives [2,3,1,4], violating R5.

defects.description: off-by-one loop guard omits the final unconsumed input element

representations.natural: [R1] Input a is nondecreasing: every earlier element is at most every later element. [R2] Input b is nondecreasing: every earlier element is at most every later element. [R3] The result length is the sum of the two input lengths. [R4] The result contains each integer exactly as many times as the two inputs combined. [R5] The result is nondecreasing: every earlier element is at most every later element.
